Entity Academic / Education

Partners Special Technology Center
Oneliner

Measurements of the level of electromagnetic radiation. Payloads: spectrometers, radio transmitter.
Description

16 different satellite missions within the framework of the Space-PI project with the participation of students and schoolchildren.
They will study the level of electromagnetic radiation on the Earth's surface in various frequency ranges. The control and signal reception center is located on the territory of the Polytechnic University.
